---
title: "Variants de barres del parc d'habitatges dels municipis litorals del Tarragonès"
lang: ca
ref: housing_bar_variants_tarragones
format:
  gfm:
    output-file: housing-bar-variants-tarragones.generated.md
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
execute-dir: project
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: r
  mode: figure
  inputs:
    - _practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/municipal-indicators-tarragones-2021.csv
  outputs:
    - assets/img/data-visualization/housing-bars-grouped-tarragones-2021.svg
    - assets/img/data-visualization/housing-bars-stacked-tarragones-2021.svg
    - assets/img/data-visualization/housing-bars-percent-tarragones-2021.svg
---

```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)

theme_tigit <- function(base_size = 13) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#e0e6eb", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#17202a", face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0, color = "#17202a"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "#17202a"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )
}

format_integer <- function(x) {
  format(round(x), big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
}

indicators <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/municipal-indicators-tarragones-2021.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

coastal_municipalities <- c("Altafulla", "Roda de Berà", "Salou", "Torredembarra", "Vila-seca")
housing <- indicators[indicators$municipality %in% coastal_municipalities, ]
housing$housing_main <- housing$housing_total - housing$housing_non_main
housing <- housing[order(housing$housing_total), ]

stopifnot(
  nrow(housing) == length(coastal_municipalities),
  setequal(housing$municipality, coastal_municipalities),
  all(housing$housing_main >= 0),
  all(housing$housing_main + housing$housing_non_main == housing$housing_total)
)

housing$municipality <- factor(housing$municipality, levels = housing$municipality)
long <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    municipality = housing$municipality,
    housing_type = "Principal",
    value = housing$housing_main,
    total = housing$housing_total
  ),
  data.frame(
    municipality = housing$municipality,
    housing_type = "No principal",
    value = housing$housing_non_main,
    total = housing$housing_total
  )
)
long$housing_type <- factor(long$housing_type, levels = c("Principal", "No principal"))
long$percentage <- 100 * long$value / long$total

palette <- c("Principal" = "#4C78A8", "No principal" = "#F28E2B")

grouped <- ggplot(long, aes(x = municipality, y = value, fill = housing_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.76), width = 0.68) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    labels = format_integer,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(title = "Barres agrupades", x = NULL, y = "Habitatges") +
  theme_tigit()

stacked <- ggplot(long, aes(x = municipality, y = value, fill = housing_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.68, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    labels = format_integer,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(title = "Barres apilades", x = NULL, y = "Habitatges") +
  theme_tigit()

percent <- ggplot(long, aes(x = municipality, y = percentage, fill = housing_type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.68, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(title = "Barres apilades al 100%", x = NULL, y = "Composició") +
  theme_tigit()

output_dir <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization")
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "housing-bars-grouped-tarragones-2021.svg"),
  grouped,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 4.8,
  device = svglite::svglite
)
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "housing-bars-stacked-tarragones-2021.svg"),
  stacked,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 4.8,
  device = svglite::svglite
)
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "housing-bars-percent-tarragones-2021.svg"),
  percent,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 4.8,
  device = svglite::svglite
)
```
